programs.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programs.desc: Follow traveling host He Tianran as he explores Xizang's many cultural treasures. Take in the majesty of the Potala Palace, discover intangible cultural heritage skills such as Tibetan paper making and Tibetan incense, and experience the plateau's natural wonders in a whole new light.

programs.title: Reborn on the Plateau - I Was a Serf
programs.desc: Alongside rare historical footage, four former female serfs reveal the stark contrast between their suffering and the lives of Xizang’s elite under the old order. This documentary bears witness to the brutality of serfdom and the profound transformation of Xizang since 1951.

programs.title: Song Dynasty Poetry: Beauty Across Time Ep.1
programs.desc: Through the lens of Song dynasty poetry, this documentary brings to life the era's great poets, their works, and the stories behind them. By delving into their values and worldview, it reveals the deeper spirit within the culture, resulting in a work that is at once thoughtful, artistic, and deeply human.

programs.title: Blue Helmets, No Borders: Special Edition Ep.1
programs.desc: Centered on two UN peacekeeping missions in Lebanon and South Sudan, this series follows Chinese soldiers as they fulfill their peacekeeping commitments, embodying the message of a \"community with a shared vision for the future\" and highlighting the contemporary significance of global governance initiatives.
